escalationBullets: If the router UI lists multiple copies of the same device, delete stale target entries before re-testing.
recommendedActions: Check the Mac's current local IP in the app.
Update the router rule so it points to the current local IP.
Reserve the Mac's IP in the router later so it stops changing.
Re-check the Mac's current local IP in Minecraft Server Controller.
Update the router rule so it points to the current host Mac address.
Reserve the Mac's DHCP address later so it stops changing.
expected.summary: Most likely cause: Your Mac's local IP changed.

notes: Companion to the exclusion fixture: same synthetic rule and rule set, but without the excluding symptom present, so the synthetic rule fires normally (score 9, strong — anyOf.count==1 so max(1,0)==1 threshold). Proves the exclusion fixture's empty result is really caused by the excludedSymptoms check, not by some other difference between the two inputs.
